District One Phase 3 is a premium villa and apartment community within Mohammed Bin Rashid City, offering a mix of ready villas and lagoon-facing residences. Residents of District One enjoy exclusive access to the iconic crystal lagoon, and a network of cycling and jogging tracks set within a secure, gated community. Combining resort-style living with unmatched proximity to the city, this semi detached townhouse presents a rare opportunity to own in one of Dubai’s most prestigious addresses.
